title: BPW-2026-0584
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0584
BOE + BCA
CD 3
LETTER OF AGREEMENT (LOA) – MADRID THEATRE RENOVATION PHASE 2 PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the proposed standalone LOA between the Bureau of Engineering and Key Code Media, Inc. to complete the project requirements previously funded under Authority for Expenditure (AE26298003M) approved in April 2026 for professional services with a budget authority of $57,000;
APPROVE and FORWARD this report with transmittals to the Office of the Mayor in accordance with Executive Directive No. 3, requesting that the Mayor authorize the President or two Commissioners of the Board to execute the finalized agreement;
AUTHORIZE the President or two Commissioners of the Board to execute the agreement upon receiving the final signed ED3 approval from the Mayor's Office; and
APPROVE revisions to the updated Authority for Expenditure (AE27298001M).
(W.O.: E1909456)
